summary: Per-chunk score-trace: a debug/trace flag that dumps the score breakdown (sim, tierW, graphScore, diversity, source) per chunk for one query, so production scoring is inspectable

resolution.note: Set RETRIEVAL_TRACE=1 to dump the per-chunk score breakdown (final score, source, sim, tierW+tier, graphScore, diversity, id) for the top-K of each query. Off by default, zero prod cost. Components are the actual scoring values, not re-derived. Verified live — visibly shows the rarity boost reordering traditions and vector hits scored at explicit inferred tier.
